title: Folk harp

title: Marimba
description: Rounded wooden mallet attack; rhythmic hooks and clear interlocking lines.

title: Soft mallet vibraphone

title: Pizzicato double bass
description: Plucked acoustic bass with alternate takes; jazz and chamber bass lines, no synth glide.

title: Bowed cello section

title: Bowed violin section
description: Small sustained violin section with recorded vibrato; lyrical lines and orchestral support.

title: Flute without vibrato
description: Airy recorded flute without vibrato; exposed melodies, including fractional-pitch harmony.

title: Solo violin
description: Solo bowed violin with recorded vibrato; exposed high string melodies.

title: French horn
description: Rounded sustained horn; cinematic calls and warm inner voices, with natural recorded pitch variation.

title: Spiccato cellos
description: Short bowed cello attacks with alternate takes; rhythmic ostinatos and replies.

title: Spiccato violins
description: Short bowed violin attacks with alternate takes; rhythmic upper strings.

title: VSCO double bass, bowed
description: Recorded sustained double bass without vibrato; orchestral low lines, not a plucked groove bass.

title: Violin palette
description: A solo vibrato, B violin section vibrato, C solo tremolo, D section spiccato. Crossfade layers with complementary gains; this is a hybrid sound, not a physical model.

title: Viola palette
description: A sustained section, B soft sustain, C tremolo, D spiccato. Crossfade layers with complementary gains; this is a hybrid sound, not a physical model.

title: Cello palette
description: A sustained section, B soft sustain, C tremolo, D spiccato. Crossfade layers with complementary gains; this is a hybrid sound, not a physical model.

title: Double bass palette
description: A bowed non-vibrato, B bowed vibrato, C pizzicato, D spiccato. Crossfade layers with complementary gains; this is a hybrid sound, not a physical model.

title: Flute palette
description: A non-vibrato, B vibrato, C expressive vibrato, D staccato. Crossfade layers with complementary gains; this is a hybrid sound, not a physical model.

title: Oboe palette
description: A non-vibrato, B recorded vibrato. Crossfade layers with complementary gains; this is a hybrid sound, not a physical model.

title: Clarinet palette
description: A sustained, B detached attacks; shorten written gates for short phrases. Crossfade layers with complementary gains; this is a hybrid sound, not a physical model.

title: Bassoon palette
description: A sustained, B recorded vibrato. Crossfade layers with complementary gains; this is a hybrid sound, not a physical model.

title: French horn palette
description: A open, B recorded muted horn; the muted source has a narrower range. Crossfade layers with complementary gains; this is a hybrid sound, not a physical model.

title: Trumpet palette
description: A open, B vibrato, C straight mute, D Harmon mute. Crossfade layers with complementary gains; this is a hybrid sound, not a physical model.

title: Trombone palette
description: A straight sustained, B recorded vibrato. Crossfade layers with complementary gains; this is a hybrid sound, not a physical model.

title: Tuba palette
description: A sustained, B detached attacks. Crossfade layers with complementary gains; this is a hybrid sound, not a physical model.

title: Tenor sax palette
description: A VCSL non-vibrato, B VCSL vibrato, C VCSL staccato, D MTG sustained. Crossfade layers with complementary gains; this is a hybrid sound, not a physical model.

title: Xylophone mallets
description: A soft mallets, B medium mallets, C hard mallets, D VSCO marimba; D is a different instrument. Crossfade layers with complementary gains; this is a hybrid sound, not a physical model.

title: String conversation
description: Independent string voices; solo lead with recorded sections below.

title: Woodwind replies
description: Flute, oboe, clarinet and bassoon exchange questions with written breaths.

title: Five brass voices
description: Two trumpets, French horn, trombone and tuba; real muted trumpet answers.

title: Quintet after the rain
description: Tenor and Harmon-muted trumpet over piano, upright bass and restrained ride.

title: Four reeds
description: Actual soprano, alto, tenor and baritone sax recordings with independent parts.

title: Orchestral handoff
description: Melody moves through woodwinds, strings and brass; harp and timpani punctuate.
